safety_review.findings: Fresh non-author reviewers, claude-sonnet-5-5 (three in parallel for the first read, then two confirm passes), read every weigh line in the ten step 1-4 banks on 2026-11-26 after the weigh-bridge rewrite (each step 1-4 คิดต่อ / Next thought line is now a question that turns the visitor, from the answer just chosen, toward what the next step asks), all three alternatives, Thai and English, against every question variant of its own bank and of the bank the option leads to. Strength, safety and every step 5 line are byte-identical to the bank reviewed on 2026-11-25 (checked by script). No line was found unsafe or to nudge toward harm. Must-fixes applied: step1.a [1] "kidneys and liver" named what separates the best options from the rest, and a later rewrite still gave away the discriminator, now builds on three days of fever and calf pain; step1.b [1] "gauge severity" echoed the best options' lines; step3 "urine output falls" echoed "Careful fluid, urine output and K"; step4.d [0] "kidneys keep failing ... and what cannot" presumed kidney failure on paths that never showed it and pointed at referral, now asks which changes would worry most; step4.d [2] "little urine comes again ... what danger" had no earlier episode and echoed "finds a dangerous potassium", now asks what to do first, and on step4.W.d, where urine is already low, "if his urine output stays low". Should-fixes taken: the tourniquet test the vignette never ran, a dangling "that result", "before the tablets run out" (gave away finishing the course) and "flooded fields" (now "paddy fields"). Every replacement was re-read against all variants in a later pass, and the last pass left no must-fix open. Second round, same day: an independent Opus re-read of the committed lines found six failing lines in a sample of 30, and seven fixes were applied as given (leptospirosis step4.W.d [0] and [2], adhf step4.W.reservoir [1], motorcycle-shock step1.e [0], step3 c [0] and step2 a/b [2], alcohol-pancreatitis step3 [2]); on the FAST paths the English says "fluid and transfusion" instead of "fluid and blood", because the checker rejects "blood" (another option label). Then three fresh claude-sonnet-5-5 reviewers that had seen no earlier pass read every step 1-4 alternative in the ten banks (1467 alternatives, 2934 lines), each against its own bank, its own strength and safety lines, and the next bank's variants, options and explanation lines, failing any wait, overnight or next-days framing where the case is urgent, any claim not in the case, any echo of the next best option, a Thai/English mismatch and unnatural Thai. 144 read, 24 failed: step1 severity lines, "while results come in" (deferred treatment), the step4 paddy-field and "call him recovered" lines, and step4.W.d [1], now "His urine is falling now; which results do you need right away for his kidneys?"; confirm passes then replaced "how sick he is" (still the severity echo), "what should he be told" (the advice option), "before he goes back" (contradicted a step 5 variant), and the R and W step4 [0] lines that deferred an active illness, now "Alongside his care now, what will you plan for after he recovers?".
